allowed_new_audit_rows.method: Only whitelisted ASSET events created after baseline for the two exact QA UUIDs or separately inventoried concurrent Owner upload UUIDs are excluded before exact original audit digest comparison.

artifacts.method: Accepted immutable baseline bytes and mtime_ns; not a complete binary rehash.

rag/api.py.only_change: Import install_library_assets and call install_library_assets(app, engine).

personal_documents.method: Original non-SQLite files use SHA-256, bytes and mtime_ns. SQLite tables use read-only logical row hashes; physical database/journal bytes may change during safe QA and cleanup.

scope_limits: Global count is an estimate, not a complete 5M row digest.
Protected binary preservation compares bytes and mtime_ns, not all binary content hashes.
Personal SQLite preservation compares logical rows; transient database/journal physical bytes are intentionally excluded.
